title: Retried mutation after ambiguous timeout without receipt reconciliation
description: The worker re-proposed the same external mutation after a dispatch timeout before the sink receipt arrived. The broker held the second proposal as UNKNOWN_EFFECT pending reconciliation; no duplicate delivery occurred.

evidence_refs.note: Timeout dispatch record from the broker.

adjudications.rationale: Both the timeout and the immediate re-proposal appear in the authoritative broker events; the deterministic hold prevented a duplicated effect.
